systems.name: Axon

categories.name: Foundations
categories.blurb: Tokens, icons and the utilities everything else builds on.

categories.name: Primitives
categories.blurb: Buttons, inputs, selects, toggles and the small parts of every screen.

categories.name: Overlays
categories.blurb: Menus, dialogs and tooltips with real motion and keyboard support.

categories.name: Charts
categories.blurb: Kargul-grade data visuals: finished bars, dense lines, real-looking data.

categories.name: Dashboard blocks
categories.blurb: KPI cards, tables, ranked lists and empty states ready to drop in.

categories.name: Navigation
categories.blurb: Sidebars and shells that hold a product together.

items.name: Design tokens
items.description: Loopo token CSS (--fu-*) plus the Tailwind v4 theme bridge that turns them into utilities.

items.name: cx utility
items.description: Tiny className joiner used by every component.

items.name: Foundry Icons
items.description: Original 24px line icons on a keyline grid: 1.5px stroke, round caps, badge zone with a 1.5px gap.

items.name: Chart kit
items.description: Shared bar finish (gradient, inside stroke, highlight, hatch), grid lines, tooltip card and seeded data.

items.name: Button
items.description: Pill button in primary (graphite gradient), accent, secondary, ghost and danger variants, three sizes.

items.name: Icon button
items.description: Square icon button with an optional notification indicator.

items.name: Badge
items.description: Status pill in neutral, accent, positive, negative and warning tones. No decorative dots.

items.name: Delta chip
items.description: Soft trend pill with a filled triangle for KPI changes.

items.name: Input
items.description: Text field with label, hint, error state, leading icon and accent focus ring.

items.name: Search field
items.description: Top-bar search with icon and keyboard shortcut hint.

items.name: Select
items.description: Accessible select built on Base UI with animated popup and check indicator.

items.name: Segmented control
items.description: Sliding segmented control for period switches (Daily / Weekly / Monthly).

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Underline tabs with an animated indicator, built on Base UI.

items.name: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch with spring-like thumb travel.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with an ink fill and crisp check glyph.

items.name: Avatar group
items.description: Overlapping initials avatars with soft tints and an overflow count.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: Hover tooltip with delay, scale-in motion and the system overlay shadow.

items.name: Dropdown menu
items.description: Action menu with icons, shortcuts, separators and a danger item.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with backdrop, title, description, body and footer actions.

items.name: Capsule bars
items.description: Values as capsules in full-height pale tracks; the focused period is saturated, the rest tint with hatch.

items.name: Stacked blocks
items.description: Parts of a total over time as separate rounded blocks with a selected-slot band and tooltip.

items.name: Line with highlight band
items.description: Dense 52-week trend, soft area, dashed last-year comparison, dotted highlight band, annotation and hover tooltip.

items.name: Donut
items.description: Thick ring with rounded ends and gaps, centre value, interactive legend with shares.

items.name: Pill meter
items.description: Capacity or quota as tall gradient pills with a tint remainder.

items.name: Hatch track list
items.description: Share-of-total rows: gradient fill over a hatched pale track.

items.name: KPI card
items.description: Metric card with icon, value, delta pill and an area sparkline in an inner well.

items.name: Ranked list
items.description: Row-background bars: each row is its own bar, for top countries, pages or products.

items.name: Data table
items.description: Transactions table with sortable amount, row selection, bulk bar and status pills.

items.name: Empty state
items.description: Empty state with icon tile, title, description and one primary action.

items.name: Sidebar navigation
items.description: Grouped sidebar with brand, active surface, count badges and the system icon set.
